body_html:
Anchor a private office with a complete, coordinated workspace. This Newland U-shaped suite pairs a 72"W table desk with a bridge, credenza, full-width hutch, and a box/box/file pedestal — a 72"W x 96"D footprint that gives executives and managers room to spread out, store, and stay organized without piecing components together one at a time.

Features

  • Complete U-shaped suite: table desk, bridge, credenza, 72" hutch, and box/box/file pedestal
  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate tops with a durable 2 mm matching edge
  • 2" square metal legs with leveling glides for a stable, level surface
  • Reversible build — assembles for left- or right-hand applications
  • Designed for quick, straightforward assembly
  • Available in the full range of Newland laminate finishes, with Tungsten, Black, or Designer White legs

Specifications

Tested to meet or exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards and compliant with GREENGUARD low-emission guidelines. Built in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 15-year warranty, with 5 years on moving and electrical parts.

Office Central is a family-owned dealer (since 1964) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario school boards, hospitals, and municipalities can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for finish selection and volume pricing, or call 1-800-835-9565.
